title: Glued component bundles with an affine section near their intersections
statement: Let X be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-reduced-scheme], C_a → X (a in Fin r) a finite closed subscheme cover [def-weil-closed-immersion], and T the union of the distinct pairwise intersections. Suppose T is finite and every point of T is closed in X. For ample invertible modules M_a on C_a [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], there is an invertible module L on X whose tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] to every C_a are ample, and a section s of L^1 with an affine nonvanishing open U containing T. No ampleness on X is concluded.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NX, proof first two paragraphs (steps 3-4 of lem-sc-reduced-dim-le-one-ample); Properties 09NV, Varieties 09NE, Limits 09NL

proof.text: Pull back the finite overlap set T to each component using injectivity of its closed immersion. Apply exists_affine_section_neighbourhood_of_finite with W=top, obtaining a positive exponent n_a, section s_a and affine locus V_a containing the inverse image of T. Let P_a=M_a.tensorPow(n_a). Apply isAmple_positive_tensorPow to retain ampleness.

Each distinct overlap is a subset of T, hence finite. Pull back the closed singletons of X to the overlap subtype to supply T1Space; Finite.instDiscreteTopology makes it discrete. Each chosen section is nonvanishing there. Apply the section clause of glueComponentLineBundles to P_a,s_a, obtaining L,t and compatible component restriction isomorphisms.

Transfer invertibility and ampleness to each tensor pullback using the component isomorphism and isAmple_iff_of_iso. Apply affine_locus_of_compatible_component_sections to the fixed glued section and the affine opens V_a. Package its section of L^1 and affine open containing T with the component ampleness witnesses. No separate nonempty-cover case is needed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_glued_component_affine_section (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced X] (r : ℕ) (C : Fin r → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a, C a ⟶ X) [∀ a, IsClosedImmersion (i a)] (hcover : (⋃ a, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ) (T : Set X) (hT : T = {x | ∃ a b : Fin r, a ≠ b ∧ x ∈ Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)}) (hfinite : T.Finite) (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ T, IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (M : ∀ a, (C a).Modules) [∀ a, (M a).IsInvertible] (hM : ∀ a, IsAmple (C a) (M a)) : ∃ (L : X.Modules) (hL : L.IsInvertible), (∀ a, ∃ h : ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj L).IsInvertible, @IsAmple (C a) ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj L) h) ∧ ∃ s : (L.tensorPow 1).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤), ∃ U : X.Opens, T ⊆ (U : Set X) ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow 1) s
